#+title: habshe-emacs — frames
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Everything frame-level by mechanism: theme (faces), fonts (face
attributes applied with frame nil, which covers all future frames
including daemon ones), frame title, and tooltip/dialog suppression.

Frame *creation* settings (bar modes, resize pair) deliberately live
in early-init, not here — they must be true before the first frame
is mapped or the bars flash. Do not migrate them down.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-frames.el"
  ;;; my-frames.el --- GENERATED from org/frames.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Frame-level appearance: theme, fonts, title,
  ;;; tooltips and dialogs.

  (defgroup my-frames nil
    "Frame-level appearance for my Emacs configuration.")

  ;; --- Theme ---------------------------------------------------------------
  ;; Modus Operandi, the light variant, loaded via the safe mechanism.
  (require-theme 'modus-themes)
  (modus-themes-load-theme 'modus-operandi)

  ;; --- Fonts ---------------------------------------------------------------
  ;; Adobe Courier everywhere, monospace by policy — variable-pitch is
  ;; set monospaced deliberately. Expressed as family + height rather
  ;; than XLFD so the size is an adjustable axis and the name is
  ;; portable; set-face-attribute with frame nil covers every future
  ;; frame, daemon included. Height is 1/10 pt: 120 = 12pt, matching
  ;; the legacy 12pt/75dpi bitmap size.
  (defconst my-frames-font-family "Adobe Courier"
    "Font family used for every face in my configuration.")

  (defconst my-frames-font-height 120
    "Default font height in 1/10 pt.")

  (set-face-attribute 'default nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height))
  (set-face-attribute 'italic nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height
                                       :slant 'italic))
  (set-face-attribute 'bold nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height
                                       :weight 'bold))
  (set-face-attribute 'bold-italic nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height
                                       :weight 'bold
                                       :slant 'italic))
  (set-face-attribute 'fixed-pitch nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height))
  (set-face-attribute 'variable-pitch nil
                      :font (font-spec :family my-frames-font-family
                                       :height my-frames-font-height))

  ;; --- Frame title ---------------------------------------------------------
  ;; Static: buffer identity is displayed elsewhere; the title never
  ;; needs to repeat it.
  (setopt frame-title-format '("GNU Emacs"))

  ;; --- Tooltips and dialogs ------------------------------------------------
  ;; Help text renders in the echo area; prompts go to the minibuffer.
  ;; Never a separate tooltip frame, never a GUI dialog box.
  (tooltip-mode -1)
  (setopt use-dialog-box nil)

  (provide 'my-frames)
#+end_src
